rows.grounds: sarvasmāt (abl. sg. n.) + karmaṇaḥ (abl. sg. n., sandhi to karmaṇo); ablative source in expiation context (vv.408-423)
jālāt (abl. sg. n. 'from net') + smṛti-tattva-kalā-vidaḥ (nom. sg. m. compound, knower of memory, truth/principle, and art); compound split by hyphens in input
tathā + api; concessive particle introducing qualification
sthiti-rakṣā-artham (acc. sg. n. purpose compound); sthiti 'stability/order', rakṣā 'protection', artham 'for the sake of'
kartavyaḥ (nom. sg. m. gerundive 'to be done') + ca + uditaḥ (nom. sg. m. 'enjoined/prescribed', sandhi codito); links duty to prescription
nom. sg. m. 'rule/injunction/rite'; subject of expiation/institutional prescription (vv.408-423)
